scope: Bounded primary-source audit of missing Aramaic/Classical Syriac and Greek common-prayer bodies. Prayer texts live in canonical content; source access and unresolved cases are distinguished here.

aramaic.targetDialect: Classical Syriac; app currently uses Erez's West Syriac texts in Hebrew square letters and Syriac script
aramaic.policy: Do not reconstruct missing liturgical text or silently substitute Modern Chaldean/Surath. Publication evidence without a visible prayer body is not a verified translation.

verifiedReadyTexts.counterpartNotes: Same ancient Marian supplication, with a line offering supplication and servants/suffering phrasing. Do not alter it to mirror the later Latin wording. Source prints no vowel points.
verifiedReadyTexts.rightsNotes: Underlying medieval liturgical text is public domain; 2011 editorial discussion and English translation remain copyrighted. Credit the edition, do not copy its modern commentary/translation into app.

aramaic.conclusion: Published Syriac Catholic sources exist for several gaps, but full source bodies could not be verified from free previews in this bounded search. This is not evidence that translations do not exist. Obtain relevant pages of Samir Georges 2019 book or a credited Erez/Church source before filling these bodies.
